title: Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program After-Hours Pickup Charge (2026-27 Schedule)
content:
The board-approved 2026-27 late pickup fee schedule of the Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program adds a flat after-hours charge to a chargeable late pickup according to how late the pickup was. Minutes late are those recorded on the pickup, counted from the plan's after-school close time.

| Minutes late | After-hours charge |
|---|---|
| at least 40 | 25.00 |
| at least 20 and less than 40 | 10.00 |
| less than 20 | nothing |

## Boundaries

| Minutes late recorded | After-hours charge |
|---|---|
| 19 | nothing |
| 20 | 10.00 |
| 39 | 10.00 |
| 40 | 25.00 |
| 58 | 25.00 |

## Basis Q&A

**Is the charge per minute?** No. It is one flat amount per chargeable late pickup, set by the band the minutes late fall in.

**Which minutes decide the band?** The minutes late as recorded on the pickup, counted from the close time itself.
